sources.title: RFC 3168: The Addition of Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN) to IP
sources.titleEn: RFC 3168: The Addition of Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN) to IP
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: CUBIC：立方視窗曲線與平臺附近增長
related.titleEn: CUBIC: cubic-window curves near the plateau
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受3%/9%作標記統計，不將它們誤稱drop rate或直接推算cwnd。 交接時須能核對：交付 ecn-events.csv、標記與遺失雙圖及端點回報核對。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept3%/9% as marking statistics, not drop rates or direct cwnd predictions. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver ecn-events.csv, separate mark/loss plots and endpoint-feedback checks.
related.difference: 建立t、t-K、Wcubic欄並把數學目標和實際cwnd分開。
related.differenceEn: Record t, t−K and Wcubic separately from the actual congestion window.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
ECN讓壅塞可由標記回報；CE標記不是封包已遺失，也不是無須降低負載。
教學基準：300/10000*100 = 3 %；對照：900/10000*100 = 9 %。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

CUBIC以距前次最大視窗的時間模型定義立方目標；實作還有TCP-friendly及ACK等約束。
教學基準：0.4*0**3+100 = 100 segments target；對照：0.4*2**3+100 = 103.2 segments target。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
ECN can signal congestion by marking; CE neither means packet loss nor permission to ignore congestion.
Teaching baseline: 300/10000*100 = 3 %; comparison: 900/10000*100 = 9 %. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

CUBIC defines a cubic target around the previous maximum; implementations also include TCP-friendly and ACK constraints.
Teaching baseline: 0.4*0**3+100 = 100 segments target; comparison: 0.4*2**3+100 = 103.2 segments target. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: HTTP Cache：Age、max-age 與新鮮度
related.titleEn: HTTP Cache: Age, max-age and freshness
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受3%/9%作標記統計，不將它們誤稱drop rate或直接推算cwnd。 交接時須能核對：交付 ecn-events.csv、標記與遺失雙圖及端點回報核對。

related.difference: 保存Date、Age、response time及resident time，明示初始age已做傳輸校正。
related.differenceEn: Preserve Date, Age, response time and residence time and state that initial age is already transit-corrected.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

HTTP新鮮度依目前age及freshness lifetime比較；收取回應後不能重新從零計原始年齡。
教學基準：600-(120+200) = 280 s freshness margin；對照：600-(120+520) = -40 s freshness margin。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

ECN can signal congestion by marking; CE neither means packet loss nor permission to ignore congestion.
Teaching baseline: 300/10000*100 = 3 %; comparison: 900/10000*100 = 9 %. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

HTTP freshness compares current age against lifetime; receiving a response does not reset its original age to zero.
Teaching baseline: 600-(120+200) = 280 s freshness margin; comparison: 600-(120+520) = -40 s freshness margin. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
